title: Exceptional-curve injection for a normalized dominating graph
statement:
Let $X,Y,X'$ be normal integral excellent Noetherian schemes of topological dimension $2$, excellence meaning excellence on every affine coordinate ring [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $f:Y	o X$ and $g:X'	o X$ be proper morphisms inducing isomorphisms of function fields, and identify all three fields with $K$ [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sc-function-field]. In $P=Y	imes_X X'$ take the reduced closed subscheme $W$ whose underlying space is the closure of the point $\operatorname{Spec}K=P	imes_X\operatorname{Spec}K$, and let $
u:Y'=W^
u	o W$ be its normalization in $K$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-sc-normalization]. Thus $W$ is the component dominating $X$, rather than the whole fibre product. Then $
u$ is finite, $Y'$ is normal integral excellent Noetherian of dimension $2$, and the projections $p:Y'	o Y$ and $f':Y'	o X'$ are proper and induce isomorphisms of function fields [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism]. For any such morphism $a:V	o T$ write $B(a)$ for the integral closed one-dimensional subschemes of $V$ mapped to one point, using reduced induced scheme structures. For every $C'\in B(f')$, the reduced image $C=p(C')$ belongs to $B(f)$, and $C'\mapsto C$ is injective. The map $p$ is an isomorphism on an open neighbourhood of the generic point $\eta_C$ of each such $C$, and it identifies $\mathcal O_{Y,\eta_C}=\mathcal O_{Y',\eta_{C'}}$ inside $K$ [def-sc-generic-point]. If $x'=f'(C')$ and $x=f(C)$, then $x'$ and $x$ are closed, $g(x')=x$, and $\kappa(x')/\kappa(x)$ is finite [def-weil-residue-field].
